profile.headline: Software Engineer | Site Reliability Engineer
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer, Production Engineering -- Ads Signals Growth
profile.summary:
Building systems and working cross-functionally are where I thrive. Taking ambiguous projects and delivering results is just another day in the life. I've had a number of opportunities to be a technical lead and drive initiates, but I'm just as comfortable being a proactive team player.

I'm also a lifelong learner and I am even working on a part-time Master's degree in Computer Science. Continuous learning helps me be better at my job and work effectively with teammates.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Production Engineering -- Ads Signals Growth
positions.description:
• Drove the adoption of Service Level Objectives (SLO) within the browser organization at Meta.  
• Enhanced mobile browser testing capabilities by developing specialized test assets.  
• Successfully migrated critical tests and alerts to a separate tenant for uninterrupted monitoring.  
• Participated in on-call rotations for infrastructure capacity and web release pipeline management.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented security features and triaged application security issues
- Worked across all engineering teams to ensure that dependencies are patched within the established Service Level Agreement (SLA).
- Onboarded a tier 0 database to help improve reliability and scalability needs - FoundationDB
- Resolved issues that lack clear ownership such as upgrading the SDK, addressing compatibility issues with the Rockset Grafana plugin, fixing bugs, and expanding the Rockset Langchain integration.
- Improved build times by debugging problematic tests and inefficient builds
- Continued supporting the Site Reliability Engineering team by continuing to participate in the 24/7 oncall rotation
- Collaborated with product managers and other tech leads to design and evaluate new projects

positions.title: Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented a traffic routing proxy to direct customer traffic to the correct server pool based on identity
- Set up a proxy to direct traffic to the appropriate region and reduce request latencies
- Developed tooling to migrate customer data to a new region
- Built utility to ingest Cloudtrail traffic ad hoc into Rockset for easy querying
- Improved observability tooling (elasticsearch, prometheus, thanos, grafana)
- Deploy pipelines and scaling systems on kubernetes
- 24/7 oncall rotation

positions.title: Principal Security Engineer
positions.description:
-Set up security services across a multi-account AWS setup (Organizations, SSO, Cloudtrail, and GuardDuty) to meet regulatory requirements and establish a baseline for security operations.
-Improved iteration on IAM changes by setting up a Terraform CD pipeline for employee access policies on AWS
-Propose changes to architecture and review features designs
-Add checkpoints in the SDLC to find vulnerabilities (dependencies, static code analysis) to raise security assurance
-Threat modeling and doing vulnerability assessments for critical subsystems

positions.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
- Directing incidents to resolution
- Coach others on incident management best practices
- Investigate and triage anomalies in platform behavior
- Troubleshoot Elasticsearch clusters trying to recover from platform issues
- Collaborate with development teams to identify ways to help platform be more resilient
- Write tools/automation in python/golang

positions.title: Team Lead, Security Development
positions.description:
In addition to the functions in my previous role:
- Coordinated effort to secure services by designing and implementing a solution for service to service authentication
- Oversaw implementation of solution for dynamically generated secrets to reduce operational cost of rotating credentials and to reduce risk exposure if credentials were ever leaked
- Launched a secure datastore for storing customer credentials for 3rd party integrations
- Reduce phishing abuse (python)
- Managed an engineering-wide effort to make our government data center to meet FIPS cryptographic standards
- Improve quality of security services with development pipelines/testing
- Introduced Scrum to team to help us iterate quicker
- Develop roadmap/budget for team

positions.title: Information Security Engineer II, Development
positions.description:
In Security Development I am working with a team to find ways to automate security processes and controls.
- Increased engineer velocity by reducing deploy times for secret management configurations from 45 minutes to 7 minutes
- Implemented controls required to meet compliance initiatives such as FedRAMP and ISO 27001
- Automate vulnerability management, auditing, account management, alerting, and reporting
- Service to Service Authentication/Authorization
- Building/Researching new tools and technologies to improve visibility and detect anomalies in our systems
- Build out and maintain a secret store for developers - dynamically generated secrets
- Automate IAM and auditing
- Raise security awareness across the company
- Train other engineers on security best best practices
positions.insights: Teamwork, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +2 skills

positions.title: DevOps/Systems Engineer II
positions.description:
Ran point on fleet and infrastructure

- Manage data center migration projects
- Automate build outs of data centers
- Explore hardware/purchasing options for data centers
- Mentor and train other engineers on operational best practices
- Work closely with security team to implement controls and meet regulations
- Acted as a "scrum master" for the team to help identify ways to be more efficient
- Worked with engineers to find ways to improve service performance and scale
- Maintain images and configuration management code (puppet)
positions.insights: Teamwork, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +2 skills

honors.title: Advanced Leadership Bronze
honors.description:
To be eligible for this award, a member must have:
- Achieved new Competent Leader award
- Achieved Competent Communicator award (or Competent Toastmaster award)
- Served at least six months as a club officer (president, vice president education, vice president membership, vice president public relations, secretary, treasurer or sergeant at arms) and participated in the preparation of a Club Success Plan while serving in this office
- While serving in the above office, participated in a district-sponsored club officer training program
- Conducted any two presentations from The Successful Club Series and/or The Leadership Excellence Series

honors.title: Competent Leadership
honors.description: Competent Leadership features 10 projects to carry out while serving in meeting roles and participating in other club activities, such as helping with a newsletter and getting involved with a membership-building campaign. An evaluator offers feedback on each of your projects, helping you to improve. Earn a Competent Leader award by completing each of the 10 projects in Competent Leadership.

volunteerExperiences.role: Head of OpenWest Young Technologist Conference
volunteerExperiences.description: As part of the larger OpenWest Conference, I ran the Young Technologists portion. The conference is a great opportunity for young techs to learn new skills in a variety of classes and technology tracks such as programming, electrical engineering, graphic design, and game development.

projects.title: Autonomous Infrastructure Platform (Personal Project)
projects.description:
- Go/React platform on AWS with Ansible deployment and Bazel builds.
- Implemented AI self-healing pipeline (anomaly detection → LLM diagnosis → human approval → automated remediation)
- Autonomous issue-to-PR dispatch.
- Zero-trust PKI with IAM Roles Anywhere.
- Kafka and Postgres architecture with feature-flagged migration strategies.

projects.title: ESP
projects.description: A lightweight log search and analysis tool.

organizations.name: Toastmaster International
organizations.position: President, Vice President of Education, Sergeant at Arms · Mar 2015 - Present
